name: Color and Normal Weighted Interpolation
aliases: Volume rendering method based on color weighted interpolation and normal vector interpolation
definition: A volume rendering technique that reduces per-resampling-point computational cost by minimizing lighting calculations and relying on interpolated attributes.
summary: Color and Normal Weighted Interpolation is a volume rendering technique that reduces computational cost by limiting lighting to one operation per sample point while interpolating color and normals to correct interface artifacts.
